content.short: Jadeswap is a Mantle DeFi platform combining AMM swaps, staking, liquidity pools, and NFT farming.
content.description: Jadeswap is a decentralized exchange and staking platform built for Mantle. The protocol lets users trade assets through AMM pools, provide liquidity, stake, and participate in NFT-related farming opportunities. Its ecosystem is centered around JADE and aims to deliver a broad DeFi experience that includes swaps, liquidity incentives, DAO-style governance, and NFT integration. By operating on Mantle, Jadeswap offers lower-cost execution for trading and farming while giving ecosystem projects another venue for liquidity and community rewards.
